overview.label: / Enterprise AI Document System
overview.description: BidPilot is an enterprise-grade AI bid execution system designed for complex RFP response workflows. From RFP ingestion to final delivery, BidPilot orchestrates multi-agent workflows to automate the entire bid response process.
overview.aiNativeDesc: Built on LangGraph multi-agent architecture with specialized agents for each workflow stage.
overview.statefulDesc: Checkpoint-backed execution with human-in-the-loop approval gates and full audit trails.
overview.enterpriseDesc: RBAC, encrypted storage, provider-agnostic LLM integration, and production-grade infrastructure.

quickstart.label: Quick Start
quickstart.title: Get Running in Minutes
quickstart.description: Move from registration to delivery inside a project workspace. BidPilot prepares the model and runtime on the server, so users do not need developer tools or a model API key in the browser.
quickstart.prereq2: A bid project with a clear scope
quickstart.prereq3: An RFP document in PDF, DOCX, or Markdown
quickstart.prereq4: Company materials, product information, or prior deliverables that can be cited
quickstart.installDesc: Sign in and create a project. Runtime status, source materials, and deliverables stay inside that project workspace:
quickstart.envDesc1: Model API keys and service connection settings are kept on the server by the platform;
quickstart.envDesc2: users never need to enter or view them in the browser.

features.label: Core Features
features.title: End-to-End Document Automation
features.description: BidPilot covers every stage of the document lifecycle, from initial ingestion to final export.
features.projectMgmtDesc: Create and manage bid projects. Each project is a self-contained workspace with its own RFP documents, knowledge base, deliverables, and review history. Search, filter, and organize across your portfolio.
features.docIngestDesc: Upload RFP documents in PDF, DOCX, or Markdown format. BidPilot automatically parses structure, extracts tables, and chunks content into searchable segments stored in MinIO.
features.reqExtractDesc: AI agents analyze the RFP and extract structured requirements: mandatory criteria, evaluation factors, compliance requirements, and submission guidelines. All requirements are linked back to source pages.
features.knowledgeDesc: The Knowledge Retriever agent uses pgvector semantic search to find the most relevant content chunks from your uploaded documents. Cosine similarity scoring ensures high-quality evidence for every section.
features.draftingDesc: The Section Drafter agent generates compliant, compelling content by combining RFP requirements with retrieved evidence. Each draft includes citations and follows your organization's tone and style guidelines.
features.qualityDesc: The Quality Reviewer agent evaluates drafts for completeness, compliance, evidence usage, and clarity. Sections below the quality threshold are automatically flagged and revised before human review.
features.approvalDesc: Critical sections pause at a human-in-the-loop gate. Reviewers can approve, request changes, or add inline comments. The workflow resumes only after explicit approval, ensuring quality control.
features.exportDesc: Export individual sections as Markdown or DOCX. Compile full deliverables with headers, formatting, and a table of contents. Version history is preserved for audit and compliance.

architecture.label: Architecture
architecture.title: Layered System Design
architecture.description: BidPilot keeps the project workspace, AI execution, business tools, and delivery records separately governed.
architecture.webAppDesc: SPA frontend with shadcn/ui components, react-router-dom routing, and TanStack Query for server state.
architecture.apiAppDesc: The service layer handles authentication, project materials, runtime state, and live progress synchronization.
architecture.workerAppDesc: Background tasks handle parsing, retrieval, drafting, review, and export; long-running work can continue after the page is closed.
architecture.dataServicesDesc: Persistent storage, vector search, task queuing, caching, and object storage for documents.
architecture.langgraphDesc: Complex document workflows support persisted progress and human approval nodes, with meaningful results written back to the project record.
architecture.workflowCode:

  ↓
Pi Agent plans and calls governed business tools
  ↓
Background parsing, retrieval, drafting, and review
  ↓
Human confirmation and version history
  ↓
Submission-ready deliverable

deployment.label: Deployment
deployment.title: Production Deployment
deployment.description: Model calls, business tools, project data, and execution records run in isolated server-side services. Users only need to enter the workspace.
deployment.platformDesc: The platform checks its core dependencies continuously and keeps important runtime state traceable:
deployment.availabilityDesc: Web, API, and Pi Agent stay available through dependency health checks.
deployment.dataIsolationDesc: Project materials and deliverables stay within organization and project boundaries.
deployment.executionTraceDesc: Tool calls, runtime results, and approval gates leave an auditable record.
deployment.deliveryHistoryDesc: Export versions and review history remain available in the project workspace.
deployment.structureDesc: Users do not need to understand internal service boundaries; this is the actual path from input to delivery.
